title: AIOS AutoResearch v0.2 Live Blind A/B Judge Finding
description: One finding emitted by the LIVE blind A/B semantic Judge (issue #414, parent #409). Additive to the frozen v0.1 schema schemas/autoresearch_semantic_finding.schema.json (issue #394), which is NOT modified. Reuses that schema's verdict (pass|revise|blocked), severity, and confidence vocabularies verbatim and adds only the live-invocation provenance fields #414 requires (finding_id, invocation_id, evaluator_version_hash, presentation_order_hash, response_hash, validation_status). Like the v0.1 schema it has NO field for authority_status/merge_status/production_status, candidate identity (which of A/B is baseline vs candidate), Researcher rationale, or a numeric aggregate score -- a Judge output cannot carry or leak any of these, by construction.

verdict.description: Reuses AI_EVAL_REGISTRY.md / AES §4.6 pass|revise|blocked verbatim. No 'fail', no 'not_run'.

confidence.description: Textual, not a calibrated probability or governance metric.

response_hash.description: sha256 of the normalised Judge response the finding was parsed from. null only when the response itself was empty (that maps to a non-pass Judge outcome, never a finding this schema would accept as valid).
